claims.citation: New York Herald, 1 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark Kate Young (Br), Young, Cardiff, 38 days, with rail-
road iron, to Boyd & Hincken. May 16, lat 41 40, lon 55 45.
spoke bark Arbutus, from Cardiff for New York; 23d, lat 41
25, lon 62 46, bark J B Duffus (Br), from St John, NB, for
Antwerp.
